⌈
If ara::diag::EcuResetRe-
quest::ExecuteReset returns any error code other than the defined error codes in [SWS_DM_01014], the Diagnostic Server instance shall return a Negative
Response with NRC equal to 0x10 (generalReject), if a final response to the request
was not sent yet.
